item.description:
TWICE 1st ARENA TOUR 2018 'BDZ' (DVD VOB)​


​
TWICE 1st ARENA TOUR 2018 'BDZ' is the first Japan-exclusive concert tour by TWICE. The tour was organized to promote their first Japanese studio album, BDZ, marking an important milestone in the group’s expansion into the Japanese music market. The tour officially began on September 29, 2018, with its opening performance at Makuhari Messe in Chiba, Japan. As their first arena tour dedicated entirely to Japan, “BDZ” highlighted TWICE’s growing international popularity and strong fanbase in the country, featuring performances of their Japanese releases alongside some of their well-known hits.
